description: The model returns text that is not valid JSON at all. pydantic's model_validate_json wraps the JSON decode failure in a ValidationError, the same exception type call_structured already catches -- with a stateless FakeLLMClient returning this same text on every attempt, every retry fails identically, exhausting max_retries and degrading to failed=true. Proves the retry-then-degrade path for a call site whose failure is INFO, not BLOCKING (see fixtures/llm/README.md's severity-divergence note).
response_text: I'm not able to determine the parameters for this row without more context.

expected_stage_issue.notes: normalize_fallback failure is INFO because the row's category was already ComponentCategory.UNKNOWN and already in `unresolved` before this call was attempted (that is the precondition for attempting it at all) -- NormalizeStage's own BLOCKING normalization_unresolved issue already covers the row independent of this outcome, so the fallback's own failure is a no-op degrade, not a new blocking condition.
